title: Thunderstorm Safety

evidence.source_text: Approaching thunderstorms may be noted by a sudden reverse in wind direction, a noticeable rise in wind speed, and a sharp drop in temperature.

nodes.text: Take storm precautions as soon as you hear thunder

evidence.source_text: Take the storm precautions below as soon as you hear thunder, not when the storm is upon you.

nodes.text: Take shelter in a vehicle or building if possible

evidence.source_text: Take shelter in a vehicle or building if possible.

nodes.text: If outdoors, find a low spot away from tall trees, wire fences, utility lines, and other elevated conductive objects

evidence.source_text: If outdoors, find a low spot away from tall trees, wire fences, utility lines, and other elevated conductive objects.

nodes.text: Pick a place that is not subject to flooding

evidence.source_text: Pick a place that is not subject to flooding.

nodes.text: If in the woods, move to an area with shorter trees

evidence.source_text: If in the woods, move to an area with shorter trees.

nodes.text: If only isolated trees are nearby, keep your distance twice the tree height

evidence.source_text: If only isolated trees are nearby, keep your distance twice the tree height.

nodes.text: If in open country, crouch low with feet together, minimizing contact with the ground

evidence.source_text: If in open country, crouch low with feet together, minimizing contact with the ground.

nodes.text: Use a pack to sit on, but never lie on the ground

evidence.source_text: You can use a pack to sit on, but never lie on the ground.

nodes.text: If you feel your skin tingle or your hair stand on end, immediately crouch low to the ground

nodes.text: Make yourself the smallest possible target and minimize your contact with the ground

nodes.text: Don’t stay on ridge tops, in wide open areas, or near ledges or rock outcroppings

nodes.text: Don’t operate landline telephones, machinery, or electric motors

nodes.text: Don’t handle metal hand tools or flammable materials in open containers

nodes.text: Do not resume work in exposed areas until 30 minutes after storm activity has passed
